approved_scope.title: Fix 325
approved_scope.no_spec_change_rationale: REQ-cli-040 already says a writer that cannot take the lock within 30 seconds refuses as refused:checkpoint-busy with nothing saved; only the evidence save's lock order and its test change.
acceptance_criteria: While another process holds the project's writer lock, chough evidence add writes no entry while it waits, and when it refuses as refused:checkpoint-busy after the wait every file is unchanged, so a rerun records one entry, not two. cases run and cases record take the lock before writing their entry too, after any case has run.

answers.constraints: The specs/cli/cli.3md lesson on native tasks applies: human gates are listed as plain text in tasks.md, not as checkboxes. The writer lock must not be held while cases run runs its case, since a writer that waits 30 seconds refuses (REQ-cli-040). No other lesson or principle constrains it.
